title: Release of Commemorative Postage Stamps on Two Decades of BRICS Cooperation
body_text:
Marking two decades of BRICS, two Commemorative Postage Stamps were released on 12 September 2026 in the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
The commemorative stamp, bearing the inscription “BRICS: Two Decades of Cooperation, 2006–2026” / “ब्रिक्स: सहयोग के दो दशक, 2006–2026”, celebrates the evolution of BRICS as a valuable platform for dialogue and cooperation.
The two stamps also capture the priorities of India’s BRICS Chairship 2026 under the theme: “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.”
While the first stamp embodies the emergence of BRICS as a platform with the spirit of mutual respect, understanding and solidarity, the second stamp displays the logo and the the vision of “humanity first” and “people-centric” vision behind India’s Chairship.
